caption:
A man moved a thorny branch and Allah forgave him

The Prophet ﷺ told of a man who found a thorny branch on the road and removed it. Allah thanked him for that deed and forgave him. Look out for one small chance to do good.

Sahih al-Bukhari 2472 · Grade: Sahih

Clear one small harm from someone's path tomorrow

#smalldeeds #removeharm #everydaysunnah #hadithreels
